channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-96655 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-110936 — Siemens Software Center
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

item.title: CVE-2025-10585 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Google Chromium contains a type confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine.

item.title: CVE-2026-110447 — Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

item.title: CVE-2026-114625 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.
